title: cleistocactus icosagonus
intro: Cleistocactus icosagonus, commonly known as the 18-petaled cactus, is a species of flowering plant in the cactus family. It is native to the tropical regions of South America and is known for its unique, star-shaped flowers and edible fruits. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including inflammation, fever, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Cleistocactus icosagonus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory effects.
